description: Create a LIVE customer SALES ORDER through the same lifecycle the Sales Orders page uses: it gets a document number, price-book pricing, tax and totals, and (when submitted) reserves stock and appears in picking. Use this for a real, open order to fulfil; use import_historical_sales_orders only for already-completed history and push_external_sales_orders only for orders fulfilled at an External warehouse. Give the store (storeId from list_warehouses' stores[].storeId — or warehouseId when that warehouse has exactly one store), the customer (customerId, customerEmail, or customerName — an unmatched name is kept as free text like the UI allows), and the lines (each itemSku, itemUpc or itemId plus a quantity; unitPrice optional — omit it to price from the price book). submit=false (default) leaves an editable draft (status "created", no reservations); submit=true issues it, which reserves stock and lands it in "pending" for picking — or in "waitingApproval" when the tenant's sales-approval flow is on. A draft is not checked against stock, so a future order (set requestedShipDate) can be recorded before the stock exists: a shortfall is returned as a warning. Submitting refuses quantities above available stock for items that do not allow backorders, exactly as the UI's Issue does. A client-pinned token only resolves its own client's items and stamps the order to that client; an operator token on a 3PL tenant must pass clientId. Max 500 lines per call.

clientId.description: Optional 3PL client id (GUID) to stamp the order to. Required for an operator (unpinned) token on a 3PL tenant; refused when it differs from a pinned token's client.

customerEmail.description: Customer email — resolved to the customer record with that email (exact match).

customerId.description: Customer id (GUID). Provide one of customerId, customerEmail, customerName.

customerName.description: Customer name — resolved to the customer record with that exact name; when none matches it is recorded as free text on the order (no customer record is created).

customerPurchaseOrder.description: Optional customer purchase-order reference recorded on the order.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

internalNote.description: Optional internal note (never shown to the customer).

lines.description: The lines to sell (max 500). Each names an item and a quantity.

itemId.description: Item id (GUID) — the alternative to itemSku. Provide exactly one of the three.

itemSku.description: Item SKU to sell. Provide exactly one of itemSku, itemUpc or itemId. Resolved against the tenant's catalog (a client-pinned token only resolves its own client's items).

itemUpc.description: Item UPC/barcode — the alternative to itemSku. Provide exactly one of the three.

quantity.description: REQUIRED. Quantity to sell, in the item's default unit of measure unless uomId is given (must be greater than zero).

unitPrice.description: Optional manual unit price in the order's currency. Omit to price the line from the customer's price book / the item's list price at commit time, exactly as the UI does.

uomId.description: Optional unit-of-measure id (GUID) for this line. Omit to sell in the item's default UOM.

orderDate.description: Optional order (demand) date, ISO 8601. Omit to date the order now. A bare date is that calendar day in the tenant's time zone.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is created until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

requestedShipDate.description: Optional date the customer asked the order to ship, YYYY-MM-DD on the tenant's calendar (a wholesale or pre-book date). While the order is open its units count as demand on that date in the stock projection and reorder timing.

storeId.description: Store id (GUID) the order belongs to — from list_warehouses' stores[].storeId (NOT the warehouse id). Provide storeId or warehouseId.

submit.description: false (default) = leave an editable draft (status "created", no stock reserved). true = also submit it: reserves stock and moves it to "pending" for picking, or to "waitingApproval" when the tenant's sales-approval flow is on.

warehouseId.description: Warehouse id (GUID) to fulfil from — accepted instead of storeId when the warehouse has exactly one store.

name: create_sales_order
title: Create Sales Order
